chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Nahdi, from Muawiya ibn Hukeym, from one of his men, from Anbasah ibn Bijad, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the Statement of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic: 'And if he is of those on the right hand, then peace to you from those on the right hand.' He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to Ali (peace be upon him): 'These are your Shites, so your children will be safe from them from being killed.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the Companions of the Right Hand according to the interpretation of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi interprets the 'Companions of the Right Hand' (Aṣḥāb al-Yamīn) of Surah al-Waqi'ah as specifically referring to the Shīʿa of ʿAlī, establishing their political and spiritual role as the protectors of the Prophet's progeny. It highlights the theological significance of the Ahl al-Bayt's lineage being preserved through their devoted followers, a key concept in Shia eschatology and leadership (Imamate).
